failure_mode: A caller writes or changes a record of an act or of a call.
cause: A position admits a write to this system, and REQ-SO-012 refuses a write by position only.
effect: The record of what the platform did is false, and Actuation can repeat or skip an act on the outside world.

failure_mode: The system stops, and nobody sees that it stopped.
cause: The process stops. A system cannot observe its own failure.
effect: No condition is escalated, no cost is reported and the user has no view of the platform. Actuation fails closed (REQ-AC-036), so the acts on the outside world stop and the user sees no reason.
detection: The service away from the host tells the user when the signals stop.

failure_mode: A measure has no threshold, so a fault in it is never escalated.
cause: No threshold was declared for a measure when it first existed, or an agent removed the threshold of a measure.
effect: A system that answers slowly or storage that a part fills reaches nobody.
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces a failure back.

failure_mode: An agent loosens a threshold, and a fault goes unseen.
cause: A change to a threshold needs no answer of the user (DEC-166). The removal of a threshold is RSK-SO-003.
effect: A system that answers slowly or storage that a part fills reaches nobody.
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces a failure back.

failure_mode: A record of an act gives life data to an agent whose position does not admit that data.
cause: A record of an act holds the arguments of the act (REQ-AC-021), and a position over the records of this system is not a position over life state.
effect: An agent reads data from a domain that its position excludes, and the data appears in its output (REQ-PL-024).

failure_mode: The platform stops, and the user is not told.
cause: The service away from the host does not run when the signals of REQ-SO-041 stop.
effect: The user finds that the platform stopped only when the user uses it.
